source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, 4)]
    rows = [r for r, c, v in cells]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    shift = (line - 1 - bottom) if bottom < line else (line + 1 - top)
    # Move the colored object until it sits next to the divider.
    out = [[4] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out[line] = grid[line][:]
    for r, c, v in cells:
        out[r + shift][c] = v
    # Mark the row immediately behind the moved object with color 8.
    marker = top + shift - 1 if bottom < line else bottom + shift + 1
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
